author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Test: Side-Effect Path Only (2000 HVGs)
abstract: This experiment isolates the 'Side-Effect Path' (FWPCA -> Combat) of the SOTA pipeline, using 2000 HVGs. It returns only the embedding, omitting the graph path entirely. This serves as a baseline to test the hypothesis that HVG truncation primarily affects the performance of the Combat-based embedding.
